As Apple (AAPL) Market Valuation Rose, Shareholder Maryland Capital Management Decreased Position; Alliance Data Systems (ADS) Holder Riverpark Capital Management Has Boosted Holding 
March 19, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy 
Maryland Capital Management decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.59% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maryland Capital Management sold 16,526 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 155,888 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $24.03 million, down from 172,414 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maryland Capital Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $892.16 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.23% or $2.19   $175.83. About 7.39 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Riverpark Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Alliance Data Systems Corp (ADS) by 1.92% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 112,447 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $24.91 million, up from 110,332 at the end of the previous reported quarter. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 16.22 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
